integrity: The structural proof is self-contained; finite computation checks consequences and does not replace the Fraïssé-limit argument.
scientific_limitations: The Pittel–Canfield partition count and Stirling/Bell formula are prior work and are not claimed as new. Originality is limited to the explicit Boolean Hamming-product Fraïssé model, exact isometry group, and orbit-profile identification; unindexed folklore remains a residual risk.
title: Hamming-product model and Bell-power orbit profile of the generic Boolean ultrametric space
